mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(fee), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_time < NOW() AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_time, end_time)), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND end_time < NOW() AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= #{start} AND start_time < #{end}

SELECT o.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS value FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.organization_id, o.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT c.student_name AS name, IFNULL(o.name, '') AS organizationName, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS fee FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY c.student_name, o.name ORDER BY fee DESC

SELECT IFNULL(o.name, '未分类') AS name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.student_name SEPARATOR '·') AS studentNames, COUNT(*) AS courseCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.fee), 0) AS fee FROM course c LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = c.organization_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.end_time < NOW() AND c.start_time >= #{start} AND c.start_time < #{end} GROUP BY o.id, o.name ORDER BY fee DESC
